sections.description:
WordPress Photo Gallery plugin

  • WordPress Photo Gallery pricing
  • Photo Gallery Free Demo
  • Photo Gallery Pro Demo
  • Photo Gallery Documentation

Easy Photo Gallery Setup for WordPress

This responsive photo gallery plugin is designed to be an easy photo gallery solution for anyone using WordPress.
You can create a clean and modern image gallery in minutes, without coding or technical setup. As a simple gallery plugin and gallery for WordPress, it works naturally with posts, pages, and most themes.
Bloggers, small businesses, and creative professionals can quickly build a WordPress photo gallery that looks professional on any device. The focus is on an easy to use gallery that stays flexible while remaining simple.

Grid, Masonry, and Mosaic Gallery Styles

The plugin includes multiple gallery layouts such as grid gallery, masonry gallery, and mosaic gallery to fit different design needs. These modern gallery layouts are designed to look balanced and professional on any website.
They work equally well for a portfolio gallery, photography gallery, or business gallery. For users who need more variety, the Pro version includes 30+ additional gallery layouts designed for different visual styles and use cases. All layouts are built to stay clean, responsive, and easy to manage.

Check out layouts demos:

  • Grid Gallery Demo – Nature Gallery
  • Masonry Gallery Demo – Photography Gallery
  • Mosaic Gallery Demo – Animals Gallery

Powerful Lightbox Gallery Experience

Every photo gallery includes a built-in lightbox gallery that enhances how images are viewed. When users click an image, it opens in a responsive lightbox that works smoothly on desktop and mobile devices. The image lightbox supports fullscreen lightbox mode, allowing visitors to focus entirely on visuals.
Inside the photo lightbox, users can access helpful features such as social share, image download, copy image, play gallery slideshow, and zoom in / zoom out for detailed viewing. This creates a complete and user-friendly gallery with lightbox experience.

Features

  • Unlimited Galleries
  • Unlimited Images
  • Image settings
  • Add multiple images at once
  • Gallery preview
  • Thumbnail Size option
  • Images ordering
  • Lazy loading
  • Global loading
  • Columns count
  • Gallery views – grid, mosaic, masonry
  • Gallery images hover settings
  • Style settings
  • Responsive design

PRO Features

  • Includes ALL Free version Features and
  • 30+ awesome views
  • 20+ Transition effects
  • 20+ Animation easing effects
  • Transition speed (in ms)
  • Lightbox overlay settings
  • Lightbox live preview
  • Share buttons
  • Full screen button
  • Images actual size button
  • Download button
  • Mouse wheel
  • Thumbnails settings
  • Key control
  • More on the way …

PRO | DEMO | DOCUMENTATION

Responsive Photo Galleries for All Devices

This plugin creates a fully responsive photo gallery that adapts smoothly to any screen size. Each responsive image gallery automatically adjusts layout, spacing, and image sizes for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
This ensures a consistent and clean mobile friendly gallery experience without additional configuration. Whether you are building a WordPress image gallery for a blog, portfolio, or business website, your galleries remain usable and visually balanced. Responsive behavior is built into every gallery layout by default.

  • Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile screens
  • Mobile friendly gallery layouts without extra setup
  • Consistent image display across different devices

Fast Loading Galleries with Lazy Loading

This photo gallery plugin is designed to keep your image gallery fast and lightweight using lazy loading images. You can choose between global lazy loading, where the entire gallery loads only when it becomes visible, or image-based lazy loading, where each image loads individually as users scroll.
The plugin also allows you to select which WordPress-cropped image size should be loaded as the image thumbnail, helping optimize performance and layout. When users open an image, the lightbox gallery displays the full-size image for maximum quality and detail. This flexible lazy load gallery setup improves speed while keeping the viewing experience sharp and professional.

Simple Customization Without Coding

This photo gallery plugin offers many styling options and flexible settings that allow you to customize every image gallery without coding. You can control colors, spacing, alignment, borders, gallery columns, and visual details to match your website design.
The plugin also lets you display image captions and image descriptions, helping add context to images in portfolios and business galleries. Subtle image hover effects and gallery hover effects can be enabled to improve interaction while keeping layouts clean. All settings are clearly organized, making this an easy to use gallery and reliable no coding gallery solution for WordPress.

Flexible Customization for Creatives, Blogs, and Small Businesses

This photo gallery plugin combines flexible customization with practical use cases for different types of websites. It is designed to adapt easily to creative and business needs while remaining easy to manage. With multiple styling options and organized settings, galleries can be customized without coding.
The plugin works reliably across various WordPress websites and content types.

  • Bloggers
  • Photographers
  • Portfolio websites
  • Designers
  • Architects
  • Make-up artists

sections.installation:
There are two ways to install Photo Gallery: the easy way, when you install Photo Gallery from your WordPress dashboard, and the not so easy way, when you install it from WordPress.org.

  • 1.1 The easiest way to enjoy Photo Gallery:
  • 1.1.1 Login to your WordPress dashboard
  • 1.1.2 Go to Plugins
  • 1.1.3 Add New
  • 1.1.4 Search for Photo Gallery
  • 1.1.5 Click to install
  • 1.2 The second way:
  • 1.2.1 Download the zip file from https://wordpress.org/plugins/
  • 1.2.2 Go to Plugins
  • 1.2.3 Add New
  • 1.2.4 Upload plugin
  • 1.2.5 Choose file ays gallery-photo-gallery.zip

  • 1.2.6 Click to install

  • 1.3 In order to install the Photo Gallery from WordPress.org you must unzip the archive and copy the gallery-photo-gallery folder into your plugins folder (\wp-content\plugins).
    After one ofthis steps you can activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
    Once activated configure any options as desired and you can enjoy our Photo Gallery.
sections.faq:
1. How do I add a photo gallery to my website? (How do I create a photo gallery for my website?)

Well, let’s see! It’s quite easy 😉
Firstly install the Photo Gallery plugin, then you will have it on the Admin Dashboard. Click on “Gallery-Photo Gallery” and push “Add new”. Then fill the Title and Description of your gallery and add images to it (you can also fill the title, description, alt, URL for each image). After clicking the button “save and close” you will see your newly made gallery with the title, description, and shortcode. Then, just take the shortcode and put it on any page or post. You can always edit your gallery – change the style, lightbox effects, etc.

2. Can I add as many images as I want in a Gallery? (How many images/photos can I add in a Gallery?)

Our WordPress Photo Gallery has no limitation on the number of images. You can add an unlimited number of images/photos in each gallery you will create. You can add them both from your computer and WordPress Media Library. For each image, you can fill Title, Alt, Description, URL.

3. Can I add 50 and more images at once?

Yes, by clicking the button “add multiple images” you can add both one and multiple photos/images to your Gallery at once. As well as you can delete the images one by one, or select several of them or all of them and delete at once.

4. Is the Gallery responsive?

Yes, our WordPress Photo Gallery is highly responsive, user-friendly and easy in use with fully responsive design and layout. Just with several simple steps, you can create stunning galleries, albums and slideshows for your site.

5. Can I add as many Galleries as I want? (How many galleries can I create?)

You can add and create an unlimited number of Galleries with our WordPress Photo Gallery plugin. Create as many galleries as you want with different titles, descriptions, styles, layouts, and lightbox effects. For each one, you will get a shortcode.

6. What Gallery views are there?

The Photo Gallery has 30+ awesome views. In the Free version, you can find 3 types of gallery views – Grid, Mosaic and Masonry. The rest are available in the Pro version.

7. Will the speed of the page fall because of many images?

Well, to avoid that we have designed 2 very important features – Thumbnail size and Global and Lazy loadings. To have fast performance you can chose between Global and Lazy loadings, also select your preferred thumbnail size.

8. Can I use Custom CSS for the Gallery?

Yes, you can use any CSS for your Gallery. The Photo Gallery plugin is fully customizable and allows you to make any changes you want. You can find that field in the “Styles” section.

9. How many Galleries can I put on the same page?

You can add as many Galleries as you want on the same page.
Note: Putting the same Gallery twice, will bring an undesirable consequence.

10. Do I get support in case of any problem?

Sure! In the Free version, you get support for 3 months for one site. In the Business Pro version, you get support for 12 months for 5 sites. In the Developer Pro version, you get lifetime premium support for unlimited sites.
